s:
Which statement is not true about Indian Time Zone?
a. India currently has just one time zone, Indian Standard Time calculated on the basis of 82.5 E longitude.
b. India's Time Zones were first established in 1884.
c. Originally there were two time zones, Bombay Time and Calcutta Time.
d. Calcutta time was 4 hours and 51 minutes ahead of GMT, while Bombay time was 5 hours and 30 minutes ahead of GMT.
